name: Natural Earth 1:50m land and lakes

mask.packing: row-major, one bit per cell, most-significant bit first; 1 land, 0 water
mask.rasterization: Integer vertex rasterization, polygon union with holes preserved; subtract union of lake polygons. Classification refers to the selected cell.

limits: Generalized 1:50m geometry and ~9.8 km equatorial raster cells. Small islands, narrow channels, exact shorelines and seasonal/historical water changes may be omitted. This is not a 2007 shoreline reconstruction. Near-coast means a 3x3 cell neighborhood contains both surfaces. The surface filter follows the selected cell with audio smoothing; no shoreline notification is triggered.
